inbox.lead: Everything CatCheck has notified you about in the app, in one place.
inbox.emptyBody: When CatCheck has something to tell you — a scan is due, scans are about to expire, a PDF record is ready — it will show up here.
inbox.emptyUnreadBody: No unread notifications among those loaded. Switch to the “All” tab to review them.
inbox.errorBody: The network or server is having trouble. Try again in a moment.
inbox.kindsLead: These four groups are the in-app notifications CatCheck plans to send.

healthFlag.title: Results worth a look
healthFlag.body: When a cat's results repeatedly fall outside the reference range.

reminder.title: Scan due
reminder.body: When a tracking schedule you set for a cat comes due.

credit.title: Scans expiring soon
credit.body: When the remaining scans in your package are about to expire.

export.title: PDF report ready
export.body: When a record you asked to export is ready to download.

push.title: Push notifications
push.lead: Get notified even when CatCheck isn't open. In-app notifications still work normally if you leave this off.
push.saved: Push notifications enabled on this device.

toggle.title: Receive push notifications on this device
toggle.body: Your browser will ask for permission to show notifications.

MISSING_VAPID_KEY.title: Push notifications aren't enabled for CatCheck
MISSING_VAPID_KEY.body: The push sending key hasn't been configured yet. You'll still get all notifications in the app and by email.

MISSING_FIREBASE_CONFIG.title: Push notifications aren't fully configured
MISSING_FIREBASE_CONFIG.body: The sending key is set, but push service connection details are missing. You'll still get all notifications in the app and by email.

IOS_NEEDS_INSTALL.title: iPhone and iPad need CatCheck installed first
IOS_NEEDS_INSTALL.body: On iOS, push notifications only work after you add CatCheck to your Home Screen and open it again from that icon.
IOS_NEEDS_INSTALL.cta: See how to add to Home Screen

UNSUPPORTED_BROWSER.title: This browser doesn't support push notifications
UNSUPPORTED_BROWSER.body: Try a recent version of Chrome, Edge or Safari. In-app notifications still work normally.

PERMISSION_DENIED.title: You've blocked CatCheck notifications
PERMISSION_DENIED.body: Browsers only ask for permission once. To turn it back on, open this site's permission settings in your browser and reload.

clientErrors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You denied notification permission, so this couldn't be turned on. Open this site's permission settings in your browser to change it.
clientErrors.PERMISSION_DISMISSED: The permission prompt was closed. Turn the switch on again if you want to retry.
clientErrors.SDK_UNSUPPORTED: This device can't register for push. In-app notifications still work normally.
clientErrors.TIMEOUT: The push service took too long to respond. Check your connection and try again.

errors.PUSH_SUBSCRIPTION_LIMIT: You've already registered {{max}} devices. Remove a device from the list and try again.
errors.CONSENT_REQUIRED: First turn on consent for “Health reminders via push notifications” in the Privacy Center.
errors.PUSH_SUBSCRIPTION_INVALID: Couldn't get a device identifier. Reload the page and try again.
errors.GENERIC: Couldn't save changes. Try again in a moment.

devices.empty: No devices are registered for push notifications yet.
